description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Harispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, owner details, extent, and encumbrances) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
